That night, he added his own short note, sealed the bottle again, and set it free at high water, watching until the dark swallowed it.","w02":"凌晨四点，城市浸在深蓝的寂静里。高楼窗灯稀落，像未眠的星。夜雨洗过街道，斑马线泛着微光；一辆出租车驶过，撕开潮湿的宁静，又很快远去。便利店亮着暖黄的灯，蒸包机冒着白汽，店员倚柜打盹。江边风凉，钓鱼人成了沉默的剪影。垃圾车停下，铁桶轻响，惊醒檐下的猫。早餐铺已生火揉面，葱香漫过巷口。天还未亮，城市已在轻轻呼吸。","w03":"- Recursion is when a way of solving a problem uses the same instruction again on a smaller piece of the problem.\n- It keeps repeating that smaller step until it reaches a simple stopping point, like reaching the smallest doll in a nesting-doll set.\n- Then it passes each answer back up, one step at a time, until the original problem is solved."}
